subsystems.name: Microphone array
subsystems.role: captures speech at high fidelity while suppressing background noise.

subsystems.name: Compute and wireless
subsystems.role: processes audio locally and streams it to the cloud over a wireless link.

subsystems.name: Power
subsystems.role: keeps the pendant running for a full day of intermittent recording.

subsystems.name: Enclosure and wearability
subsystems.role: houses the electronics and attaches to clothing or a lanyard.

subsystems.name: Cloud AI service
subsystems.role: transcribes speech, generates summaries and stores searchable memories.

subsystems.name: Privacy and security
subsystems.role: gives the wearer control over what is recorded and shared.
parts: encryption in transit and at rest

buildSteps.title: Design the electronics
buildSteps.detail: Choose a low-power SoC, microphones, battery and radio, then lay out a compact printed circuit board.

buildSteps.title: Write the firmware
buildSteps.detail: Implement audio capture, Bluetooth pairing, power management and a local wake-word engine.

buildSteps.title: Build the cloud pipeline
buildSteps.detail: Set up speech-to-text, an LLM for summarisation, and a database that stores transcripts and embeddings.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the hardware
buildSteps.detail: Solder components, connect the battery, and fit everything into the enclosure with the microphone ports.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate the microphones
buildSteps.detail: Test audio capture in cafés, cars and windy streets, then tune beamforming and noise suppression.

buildSteps.title: Test battery and connectivity
buildSteps.detail: Verify all-day battery life under realistic use and confirm reliable pairing and cloud sync.

buildSteps.title: Certify and manufacture
buildSteps.detail: Pass electromagnetic, safety and privacy compliance tests, then start mass production.

buildSteps.title: Deploy and update
buildSteps.detail: Ship the device, push over-the-air firmware updates and improve the cloud models over time.
